message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on facts. The scenario: employer (谭某某) without construction qualification, fails to ensure safety measures, causing worker death from fall from scaffolding. This is a major responsibility accident (重大责任事故) as per Chinese criminal law: causing death due to safety negligence in production safety, leading to a major accident. In examples, similar facts (construction safety negligence leading to death) were labeled "重大责任事故". So answer: [罪名]重大责任事故<eoa>.

Check if any other charges like "过失致人死亡" maybe? In Chinese criminal law, causing death due to negligence in safety production is "重大责任事故罪" (major responsibility accident crime). The examples: first case (浙江省宁波市镇海区) was labeled "重大责任事故". Also other similar: coal mine accident etc. So answer single charge.

Thus final JSON with reasoning and final answer.
